name: footer-simple
title: Footer Simple
blurb: Minimal footer with brand tagline, social/legal links, and copyright bar.
description: A clean, light-themed footer with branding area, two-column link grid (Social and Legal sections), and a bottom copyright line. Spans min-height viewport.
use_when: Corporate sites or minimal product pages needing a straightforward footer without heavy branding.
avoid_when: Dark theme pages or when you need theme flexibility; the footer is hardcoded to light colors.
a11y: Semantic `<footer>` element. All links are keyboard-accessible with hover states. Uses proper heading hierarchy (text-sm for section labels).
